# Your title

This page answers how other programs call this feature over a network protocol: public HTTP routes, RPC methods, and events. Command-line calls belong in the cli page; internal inter-process communication belongs in the architecture page.

## Endpoints

List each route, method, or event with its purpose.

## Requests and Responses

Define exact request and response shapes, status codes, and headers that callers rely on.

## Errors

List each error and its status code. When the error is defined on another behavior page, link it and state only the mapping for this protocol.

## Compatibility

State which changes keep existing callers working and which require a new version.
